messages:
Sam (VP Eng): Quick follow-up from the All-Hands Q&A  we landed on biweekly majors. Need a tight checklist for teams  what are the must-haves for a major vs minor?
Priya (Product): For PMs: major = public API, data schema, billing, infra changes that affect latency. Minor = UI, internal non-breaking features. Can we put a decision table in the template?
Ben (Release Eng): I'll add a release_type field and freeze_date to the template. Ops owner required for majors. Also propose a short 'release owner' slot for the day-of.
Carmen (SRE): Operational rules: canary >= 4h for majors, staged ramp, and a 48h post-rollout watch. Auto-incident if error_rate > 0.4% or p99 > baseline * 1.3. Pager oncall if incident fires.
Devin (QA): QA gates: smoke pass on staging, full regression on staging, top-200 prompt eval < 3% regression. No open critical bugs. I'll draft a one-page checklist.
Ana (Head of Infra): For Dedicated customers we need 72h notice + opt-out windows. If a customer opts out we schedule them into next window; ops to track opt-outs. Also document maintenance window policy.
Laila (Customer Success): We'll prepare the customer blurb. Keep it simple: "Planned major releases may cause brief disruptions; we provide rollback and a post-release report." Ops to review tone.
OpsBot: "Deploy plan created: canary -> 10% for 30m, then 50% over 1h, monitor p95/p99/error-rate. Rollback threshold: error_rate delta > 0.4% OR p99 > baseline*1.3."
Ben (Release Eng): Suggest adding a short regression command snippet into the checklist so engineers can run quick checks before cut.
Devin (QA): Snippet below (copyable):
```
# quick_regression.sh
python eval/run_regression.py --prompts top200.txt --baseline baseline_v4.json --candidate build_042 --max_regression 0.03
```
I'll link the full harness in Confluence.
Carmen (SRE): Rollback policy: immediate rollback if critical user paths fail during canary or 48h watch. For marginal failures, page the release owner and give 30m for mitigation before rollback. We'll automate incident creation.
Ben (Release Eng): I'll post the updated ticket JSON and a minimal checklist in Confluence. Please review before Friday.
Priya (Product): PM ask: can Ops tag releases in the roadmap with 'major' so PM timelines reflect cadence?
Ana (Head of Infra): Yes, ops can add metadata. Also we'll update the oncall runbook to include release-day verification tasks and who covers them.
Laila (Customer Success): CS will send a 72h heads-up for majors and a post-release note after the 48h watch. For Dedicated customers, include opt-out instructions.
Sam (VP Eng): Leadership asks: keep majors predictable, minimize customer impact, and keep hotfixes fast. Ops + Release + QA finalize checklist by EOW so we can pilot the next window.
Ben (Release Eng): Owners summary: Ben (ticket template + release owner slot), Devin (QA checklist + harness link), Carmen (monitoring + rollback automation), Ana (Dedicated customer policy + oncall runbook), Laila (customer comms). I'll schedule a 30m sign-off Friday.
Priya (Product): Thanks all  will add decision table and acceptance criteria to the release ticket template.
Sam (VP Eng): Closing thread  please drop links here when done.
